message: <input type="checkbox"> has no label. Add <label for="…">…</label> or wrap it in a label (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2).
placeholder doesn’t apply to <input type="checkbox">; it applies to type="text", type="search", type="tel", type="url", type="email", type="password", or type="number".
maxlength doesn’t apply to <input type="checkbox">; it applies to type="text", type="search", type="tel", type="url", type="email", or type="password".
<input type="text"> has no label. Add <label for="…">…</label> or wrap it in a label (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2).
min doesn’t apply to <input type="text">; it applies to type="date", type="month", type="week", type="time", type="datetime-local", type="number", or type="range".
max doesn’t apply to <input type="text">; it applies to type="date", type="month", type="week", type="time", type="datetime-local", type="number", or type="range".
target doesn’t apply to <a> without href.
rel doesn’t apply to <a> without href.
<input type="file"> has no label. Add <label for="…">…</label> or wrap it in a label (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2).
